name: FUN_STREAM_NOTIFICATIONS
description: This table contains mapping of functional process notification details.

columns.name: STREAM_NOTIFICATION_ID
columns.description: Notification details options unique identifier.

columns.name: STREAM_ID
columns.description: Functional process options reference identifier.

columns.name: STREAM_STEP_ID
columns.description: Functional process stream step options reference identifier.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role code for which notification will be issued.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of notification for the user eg. bell, bell and email.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_CONDITION_CODE
columns.description: Notification has to be sent on success or on failure of the Job - Always or On Success or On Error.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Notification setting has been enabled or not (Y/N).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
